title: Function Health section heading
description: A light high-contrast serif heading, 48px on phones up to 64px, tight leading, with one italic terracotta phrase (or a struck-through one). Optional lead line in the grotesk underneath. Centred by default.
notes: needs a serif display font with an italic (the theme provides one)
the title is a list of plain strings and { accent } parts, so the italic phrase can sit anywhere
name: functionhealth-heading

props.name: title
props.description: the heading as parts, in order; include the spaces between them, e.g. ["Testing is ", { accent: "easy" }]; the part "\n" is a line break

props.name: as
props.description: h1 for the page title, h2 for sections

props.name: textClassName
props.description: extra classes for the lead line
